fix_code:
def main():
    N, M = map(int, input().split())
    A = list(map(int, input().split()))
    B = list(map(int, input().split()))

    ans = "No"
    C = sorted(A + B)
    for i in range(len(C) - 1):
        if C[i] in A and C[i + 1] in A:
            ans = "Yes"
            break
    print(ans)
